generalFailureModes.rootCause: Equivalent obligations that differ only by non-semantic conjunctions are projected as separate Tasks.
generalFailureModes.guard: Require equal action predicate plus normalized object equivalence and overlapping event or literal evidence; map both obligations to one Task without deleting either Fact.

generalFailureModes.rootCause: A raw applicability ambiguity and a condition-derived applicability ambiguity use different Evidence IDs and survive as duplicate user prompts.
generalFailureModes.guard: Merge only equivalent applicability prompts with overlapping literal source spans; preserve the union of Evidence IDs.

generalFailureModes.rootCause: An action predicate and object copied from a literal source span is marked strong_inference solely because it was recovered by the adapter.
generalFailureModes.guard: Literal-source actions with exact evidence are explicit; no new action may be inferred.

generalFailureModes.rootCause: Frozen raw TimePoint treats a vague day period as an exact normalized clock value.
generalFailureModes.guard: Do not let Planner or Normalizer mutate extractor-owned time facts; carry as an explicit upstream risk.

generalFailureModes.rootCause: Frozen raw facts contain the completion Task but do not register its deliverable as a Material fact.
generalFailureModes.guard: Planner must not manufacture a Material from a Task object.

positiveControls: Pure-information Event and TimePoint preservation without Task invention
Required attendance represented as Task while retaining Event
Vague event times remain null and require confirmation when the frozen Fact is already vague
Literal multi-material upload object remains explicit and directly checkable
